claims.claim: Reported sales for the second quarter of 2026 were $25.3 billion.
Second-quarter 2026 reported sales represented 6.6% growth over the prior year.
Reported (GAAP) diluted EPS for the second quarter of 2026 was $2.27.
Non-GAAP adjusted operational sales growth for the second quarter of 2026 was 5.7%.
Non-GAAP adjusted diluted EPS for the second quarter of 2026 was $2.90.
Non-GAAP free cash flow for the second quarter of 2026 was approximately $8.7 billion.
claims.note: The release reports ~$8,700 million as second-quarter YTD 2026 free cash flow (estimated as of July 15, 2026), not the quarter alone. The quarterly figure is not disclosed and cannot be derived from the release.

claims.claim: Innovative Medicine reported sales were $16.384 billion in Q2 2026.
Innovative Medicine reported sales grew 7.8% year over year.
Innovative Medicine growth was driven by DARZALEX, CARVYKTI, TECVAYLI and RYBREVANT/LAZCLUZE in Oncology.
Innovative Medicine growth was driven by TREMFYA and other products in Immunology.
Innovative Medicine growth was driven by SPRAVATO and CAPLYTA in Neuroscience.
Innovative Medicine growth was partially offset by STELARA, REMICADE, IMBRUVICA and ZYTIGA.
MedTech reported sales were $8.926 billion in Q2 2026.
MedTech reported sales grew 4.5% year over year.
MedTech growth was driven by wound closure and biosurgery products in Surgery.
MedTech growth was driven by electrophysiology products and Shockwave in Cardiovascular.
MedTech growth was driven by contact lenses in Vision.
MedTech growth was driven by trauma in Orthopaedics.
The company raised 2026 estimated reported sales guidance to a range of $100.8 billion to $101.4 billion, with a midpoint of $101.1 billion.
Raised 2026 estimated reported sales guidance implies 7.3% growth at the midpoint.
The company raised 2026 non-GAAP adjusted EPS guidance to a range of $11.60 to $11.75, with a midpoint of $11.68.
Raised 2026 adjusted EPS guidance implies 8.2% growth at the midpoint.
The company raised 2026 non-GAAP adjusted operational EPS guidance to a range of $11.50 to $11.65, with a midpoint of $11.58.
Raised 2026 adjusted operational EPS guidance implies 7.3% growth at the midpoint.
The company reported non-GAAP free cash flow of approximately $8.7 billion for the second quarter of 2026 (restated in the Capital and balance sheet section).
claims.note: Same error as in the Results section: ~$8,700 million is the second-quarter YTD 2026 estimate, not a quarterly figure.

claims.claim: The company announced an investment of more than $1 billion to strengthen U.S. Vision manufacturing in Jacksonville, Florida.
Johnson & Johnson is acquiring Firefly Bio, Inc. to expand its oncology pipeline.
